rows.candidateRo: Și DOMNUL a zis: „Pune-i numele Lo-Ami căci voi nu sunteți poporul Meu, și Eu nu voi fi Dumnezeul vostru.”
rows.WEBUText: He said, “Call his name Lo-Ammi, for you are not my people, and I will not be yours.

rows.candidateRo: Totuși numărul copiilor lui Israel va fi ca nisipul mării care nu se poate nici măsura, nici număra; și de unde li se zicea: „Nu sunteți poporul Meu”, li se va zice: „Copiii Dumnezeului celui Viu”
rows.WEBUText: Yet the number of the children of Israel will be as the sand of the sea, which can’t be measured or counted; and it will come to pass that, in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’

rows.candidateRo: Atunci copiii lui Iuda și copiii lui Israel se vor strânge la un loc, își vor pune o singură căpetenie și vor ieși din țară; căci mare va fi ziua lui Izreel.
rows.WEBUText: The children of Judah and the children of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint themselves one head, and will go up from the land; for great will be the day of Jezreel.

rows.WEBUText: “Say to your brothers, ‘My people!’ and to your sisters, ‘My loved one!’

rows.WEBUText: Contend with your mother! Contend, for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband; and let her put away her prostitution from her face, and her adulteries from between her breasts;

rows.WEBUText: I will sow her to me in the earth; and I will have mercy on her who had not obtained mercy; and I will tell those who were not my people, ‘You are my people;’ and they will say, ‘You are My God!’”

rows.WEBUText: The LORD said to me, “Go again, love a woman loved by another, and an adulteress, even as the LORD loves the children of Israel, though they turn to other gods, and love cakes of raisins.”
